Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks slip as AI fears weigh on software, while oil and rate bets add pressure
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks fell as fears of AI disruption hit software shares, alongside pressure from rising oil prices and shifting Federal Reserve rate expectations. Investors awaited inflation data and monitored Middle East tensions while reassessing the outlook for interest rates and equities.

Markets.title: Rentomojo IPO: BlackRock among investors in Rs 376 crore anchor round
Markets.summary: Rental furniture startup Rentomojo raised Rs 376 crore from 41 anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering starting September 9. Major institutional investors including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and HDFC Mutual Fund participated by purchasing 93 lakh shares at Rs 404 each.

Markets.title: ARCIL IPO: Goldman Sachs, BofA among investors in Rs 220 crore anchor round
Markets.summary: Asset Reconstruction Company India raised Rs 220 crore from anchor investors by allotting 1.58 crore shares at Rs 139 each. Goldman Sachs and BofA Securities were among the 21 investors participating in the round ahead of the company's September 9 IPO.

Markets.title: NSE likely to price IPO at Rs 1,700-1,785 per share after a cut, say sources
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India plans to lower its IPO price range to Rs 1,700-1,785 per share. It may also reduce the offered stake to 5.5%, valuing the exchange at up to 4.42 trillion rupees.

Markets.title: Karamtara Engineering raises Rs 262 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO. HDFC MF among top buyers
Markets.summary: Karamtara Engineering raised Rs 262.50 crore from anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering, with participation from domestic mutual funds and insurance companies. The solar module mounting structure manufacturer's IPO opens for subscription on September 9 and closes on September 11.

Markets.title: Jio IPO: Co set to begin investor outreach later this week, say sources
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms is starting global investor outreach this week for its upcoming initial public offering following regulatory approval. The telecom giant plans to use the capital raised from fresh equity shares primarily to repay a subsidiary's debts.

Geo-Political.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
Geo-Political.summary: The UK has imposed sanctions on West Bank settlers and accused them of ethnic cleansing against Palestinians. In response, Israel has shut down the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

Geo-Political.title: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
Geo-Political.summary: British-Israeli relations have reached their lowest point in decades following London's implementation of a trade ban on Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel's sharp reaction to the ban underscores the critical juncture currently facing diplomatic ties between the two nations.

Geo-Political.title: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has imposed tariffs as high as 50% on nearly $20 billion worth of U.S. products, ranging from steel to T-shirts. Canadian official Mark Carney stated that the ongoing trade war with the United States will come at a cost.

Geo-Political.title: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
Geo-Political.summary: Renoir paintings worth millions of dollars were stolen during a museum heist in France. This incident is the latest in a series of high-profile art thefts across Europe.

Geo-Political.title: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
Geo-Political.summary: Argentina plans to file a criminal case against an oil company operating in the Falkland Islands. This action follows recent statements by President Javier Milei intensifying Argentina's sovereignty claims over the territory.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone strike hit a Ukrainian TV channel building in Kyiv, resulting in five deaths. President Zelensky condemned the daytime attack as a new page in Russian degradation.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help creators improve their digital content production in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the content creation process and simplifying work for creators.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: RBI overnight cash withdrawal auction: Banks park  ₹3.53 lakh crore after tepid 30-day auction
Data & Insights.summary: On September 7, banks showed little interest in the RBI's 30-day variable rate reverse repo (VRRR) auction, submitting bids below the notified amount. In contrast, a subsequent overnight cash withdrawal auction attracted strong participation as banks parked ₹3.53 lakh crore, preferring shorter parking periods.

Data & Insights.title: Why India’s 7.8% GDP growth isn’t enough to celebrate
Data & Insights.summary: India has achieved a post-pandemic GDP growth rate above 7%. However, this economic expansion remains insufficient to meaningfully improve the living standards of the general population.

Data & Insights.title: US-Iran war impact: India adds new suppliers amid crude supply disruption, but only 5 nations control imports — Check
Data & Insights.summary: Despite expanding its crude oil sourcing to 31 countries to counter US-Iran war disruptions, India's import concentration rose sharply. Currently, just five nations control the majority of India's crude imports.

Data & Insights.title: 'Fictional, loose figment of irrational tit-bits': SBI report refutes claims of missing nominal GDP data
Data & Insights.summary: An SBI Ecowrap report dismissed claims of missing national GDP data as unfounded fiction. It stated that Q1 FY27 GDP growth estimates are reliable and that data revisions are standard statistical practice.

Data & Insights.title: India plans to pool factory energy demand to power a green switch
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to pool factory energy demand to facilitate bulk purchases of green power for manufacturers. This initiative aims to secure better prices, reduce energy costs, and lower emissions.

Data & Insights.title: CII business confidence rebounds in Q2 on improving demand, hiring and investment outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in Q2FY27. This rebound was driven by stronger domestic demand, higher capacity utilization, and easing cost pressures.

India.title: Delhi's Hauz Rani Fire, Hostel Collapse: 3 Officials, 2 Tragedies, 1 Question
India.summary: Three Municipal Corporation of Delhi officials have been suspended following two separate building collapses in Malviya Nagar and Satya Niketan. These tragedies resulted in a total of 30 deaths across the capital.

India.title: Ex-Delhi Chief Secretary Rakesh Mehta Dies By Suicide In Noida Flat
India.summary: Former Delhi Chief Secretary and 1975-batch IAS officer Rakesh Mehta has died by suicide in his Noida apartment. He previously served as a top bureaucrat under former Chief Minister Sheila Dikshit.

India.title: "No Work, No Pay": Punjab Cracks Down On Unauthorised Absence Of State Staff
India.summary: The Punjab government issued a "no work, no pay" rule to address unauthorized absences among state employees. Officials received reports that multiple staff members were leaving their workplaces after marking their attendance.

India.title: Assam Ex-Bureaucrat, 2 Journalists Join BJP Ahead Of State Bypoll
India.summary: An ex-bureaucrat and two journalists have joined the BJP in Assam ahead of the upcoming state bypolls. This move has sparked speculation that the former bureaucrat might receive a party ticket for the Nagaon election.

India.title: Delhi Building Collapse Highlights: Rekha Gupta Visits AIIMS, Promises Support To Building Collapse Victims
India.summary: Rekha Gupta visited AIIMS to promise support to the victims of a building collapse in the densely populated student area of Satya Niketan near Delhi University's South Campus. The locality is known for housing numerous students in its various hostels and accommodations.

General.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response

General.summary: British-Israeli relations have reached their lowest point in decades following the UK's decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel's strong reaction to the trade ban highlights the significant tension between the two governments at this time.

General.title: More flight delays expected after hundreds cancelled by air traffic control glitch
General.summary: A technical problem at air traffic control provider Nats has caused hundreds of flight cancellations. Passengers departing from multiple airports should expect further delays as a result.

General.title: RNLI boss says volunteers facing 'unacceptable' abuse
General.summary: RNLI chief executive Peter Sparkes stated that volunteer crews are facing unacceptable abuse due to deliberate misinformation spread about the charity. He condemned these attacks on the rescue organization and defended the volunteers' life-saving work.

General.title: Glastonbury confirms ticket sale dates - and highest ever price
General.summary: Glastonbury Festival has announced the ticket sale dates for its return in June following a fallow year. For the first time, ticket prices have exceeded £400.

General.title: Trump shares misleading video of King and fainting worker
General.summary: Donald Trump shared a misleading video that appears to show King Charles walking away from a man who fainted during a royal visit. In reality, the King stopped to check on the worker and waited with him until medical assistance arrived.
